title: Graduate Trainee Engineer
company: Switchgear and Control Technics Private Limited
description: Role Summary We are looking for a motivated fresh engineering graduate to join our Projects team and learn the end-to-end execution of Supply, Installation, Testing Commissioning (SITC) projects for LV electrical panels. Working under the guidance of Project Managers, the trainee will support planning, drawing coordination, plant follow-up, site activities and project documentation, and grow into a Project Engineer role. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Support Preparing project schedules, trackers and progress reports. Maintain project files – purchase orders, technical specifications, drawings and correspondence. Track material status and delivery timelines and update the project team. 2. Drawings Documentation Support preparation and submission of GA drawings, SLDs, BOMs and technical documents for customer approval. Maintain the drawing register and revision records. Key Skills Attributes Learning Attitude: Eager to learn and take ownership of assigned tasks. Communication: Clear written and verbal communication in English. Attention to Detail: Organised and accurate with documents and records. Teamwork: Works well with design, production and site teams. Mobility: Willing to travel and stay at project sites as required. What You Will Learn Complete SITC project lifecycle for LV electrical panels. Customer drawing approval, FAT and site commissioning processes. Data centre and industrial project execution practices. Project planning, coordination and customer handling skills.

title: Graduate Trainee Engineer - Electrical/ Mechanical/ Electronics
company: Switchgear and Control Technics Private Limited
description: Role Summary The Technical Antenna is the company's technical reference for the Schneider Electric BlokSeT LV switchboard system. The role makes sure every BlokSeT panel we design and build follows the BlokSeT LV standard. It is also the main technical contact with Schneider’s Partner Support (PSP) team. The Technical Antenna maintains the BlokSeT technical transfer file, checks quality, trains internal teams, and supports the design, tendering and estimation teams on BlokSeT technical questions. Key Responsibilities 1. BlokSeT LV Standard Compliance Control and ensure that every BlokSeT switchboard is designed, assembled and tested according to the BlokSeT LV standard and Schneider guidelines. Check designs and panel layouts against BlokSeT configuration rules and IEC 61439 requirements. Flag any deviation from the standard and drive corrective action with the design and production teams. 2. Communication with Schneider PSP Act as the single point of contact with the Schneider Electric PSP team for local adaptation and design queries. Raise technical queries, get clarifications and approvals for non-standard or locally adapted solutions, and track them to closure. Keep up to date with Schneider technical updates, new references and changes to the BlokSeT system. 3. BlokSeT Technical Transfer File Maintain the BlokSeT technical transfer file – technical manuals, assembly instructions, configuration guides and updates. Make sure the design, production and QA teams always use the latest approved revision of each document. Keep records of local adaptations, Schneider approvals and technical correspondence ready for audit. 4. BlokSeT Quality Control Carry out quality checks on BlokSeT panels during assembly and before dispatch, against BlokSeT checklists. Support routine testing and verification and make sure test records are complete. Support Schneider audits and close any non-conformities that are raised. 5. Internal Team Training Train design, production, QA and project teams on the BlokSeT system, assembly rules and quality requirements. Prepare simple training material and keep a record of training given. 6. Support to Design Team Guide the design team on BlokSeT technical aspects – configuration, busbar systems, functional units and form of separation. Review GA drawings and BOMs for BlokSeT panels for technical correctness. 7. Support to Tendering Estimation Read and analyse RFQ documents and technical specifications, and identify BlokSeT-related requirements. Help the tendering and estimation team with BlokSeT technical details, compliance statements and the right configuration. Get Schneider support on technical clarifications needed during tendering. Required Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in in Electrical or Electrical Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Fresher or up to 1 year of experience in LV switchboards / panel design (BlokSeT exposure is an advantage). Basic understanding of LV switchgear – ACBs, MCCBs, busbars, protection and form of separation. Basic knowledge of IEC 61439 is an advantage. Ability to read electrical drawings (SLDs, GA drawings); basic AutoCAD knowledge is a plus. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Key Skills Documentation Reading: Read and understand technical documents, manuals and standards. Technical Analysis: Review and analyse technical requirements of RFQs and specifications. Strong Communication: Clear, confident spoken and written English to deal with Schneider and internal teams. Documentation: Organised and accurate record-keeping and document control. Learning Attitude: Eager to learn and become the in-house BlokSeT expert. Key Performance Indicators All BlokSeT panels compliant with the BlokSeT LV standard. Schneider PSP queries raised and closed on time. Technical transfer file kept complete and up to date. Zero major non-conformities in Schneider audits. Number of internal training sessions delivered. Timely technical support to design and tendering teams.

Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation. Job Description Are you an engineer who's more excited by AI, problem-solving, and building a career with real impact than by writing code for the next 20 years? This role is built for engineering graduates who want to launch a high-growth career in global enterprise technology sales — no prior sales experience required. About Zycus Zycus is a global leader in AI-powered procurement technology, helping Fortune 1000 organizations transform how they source, contract, procure, and manage suppliers. Recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Source-to-Pay Suites, we're redefining enterprise software with Agentic AI — autonomous procurement workflows that help the world's largest organizations make faster, smarter decisions. If you're excited about AI, enterprise technology, and building a global career, this is where it begins. About the Role As a Business Development Executive (BDE), you'll identify and engage enterprise prospects across North America, Europe, APAC, and other global markets, and create qualified opportunities for our enterprise sales teams. This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You'll use cutting-edge AI tools, sales intelligence platforms, and multi-channel outreach to work smarter, not harder. Think of it as applied problem-solving: research a target, understand their challenges, engineer the right message, and open the door to a conversation. You'll work alongside experienced Account Executives, Sales Leaders, and AI-powered systems — learning modern enterprise selling from day one. Why This Role Is Built for Engineers We've found that engineering graduates thrive in this role because the skills that got you through your degree are exactly what modern selling rewards: Analytical thinking — you break complex problems into parts. That's how you qualify a prospect and map their needs. Comfort with technology and data — you won't be intimidated by CRMs, sales intelligence tools, or AI workflows. You'll master them fast. A builder's mindset — the best BDEs experiment, measure, and iterate on their outreach the same way you'd debug and optimize a system. AI fluency — you already learn new tools quickly. At Zycus, AI is how we work, and engineers pick it up naturally. You don't need a sales background. You need curiosity, energy, and the willingness to learn. We'll teach you the rest. What You'll Do Research and identify enterprise accounts that fit Zycus' Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and other sales intelligence platforms. Use AI tools to personalize outreach at scale across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels. Generate qualified meetings and opportunities for the sales team. Execute multi-touch outbound campaigns across global markets. Qualify prospects by understanding their business challenges and procurement transformation initiatives. Maintain accurate CRM data and pipeline hygiene. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and AI teams to optimize outreach strategies. Continuously experiment with new prospecting techniques, messaging, and AI workflows. Meet and exceed monthly targets for meetings booked, opportunities created, and Net New Accounts Added (NAA)
